items.source_en:
I had been taking my morning walk when it happened. There was a great rumble from the Scaled Citadel, followed by a flash of blinding light. 

I thought it was a clash of thunder and lightning, until I realized the order was reversed. I turned around to find myself face to face with a wall of "vortex," and half the city vanished in a cosmic blink. I panicked, scrambling home to House Ka'dic. I remember the cascading sense of relief and dread as I saw my home was intact, but others were not.

I imagine there are stories like mine all over Dreshdae, and perhaps when this is all over, there will be time to document them. For now, here are mine.
